clean_story:
"Numbers in action. Solving real problems.
Applied Mathematics means using math to crack practical puzzles, like a locksmith picking locks with equations instead of tools.

A bridge’s curve resists wind because engineers used calculus to shape it. A phone’s GPS finds the fastest route by solving millions of tiny distance problems per second. These are not theories—they’re math turned into steel and signals.

Stock markets use differential equations to predict price swings. Hospitals optimize nurse schedules with linear algebra. Each solution starts with raw numbers and ends with a working system.

Three related subjects are operations research, computational modeling and chaos theory."
